name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Add a single high-contrast skip link at the top of every page that only appears when focused. This ensures keyboard users can bypass repetitive navigation blocks without cluttering the visual design for mouse users. The trade-off is a small, temporary shift in layout when the link gains focus, but it’s negligible compared to the barrier removal for assistive tech users.

name: Reader
text:
Risk: A single skip link at top fails when the page has multiple distinct navigation blocks (e.g., main nav, sidebar nav, footer nav). Keyboard users must tab through each block to reach the next skip link, breaking the bypass promise. Always-showing skip links clutter the top for sighted users, but hiding them until focus risks missing the first block entirely.

Better alternative: Place a skip link before every major navigation block. Settle by testing with a screen-reader user on a page with three nav sections; if they can’t bypass the second block in under three tabs, the design fails.

name: Ramp
text:
Add a skip link at the very top of every page that jumps to the main content, plus a second skip link at the very bottom that jumps back to the top. This guarantees keyboard users can bypass all navigation blocks in one tab stop each way. The trade-off is two extra focusable elements in the DOM, but they stay hidden until focused and don’t harm sighted users’ flow.

name: Reader
text: Risk: Two skip links still fail when the page has *three* or more distinct navigation blocks (e.g., header, sidebar, footer, in-page nav). Keyboard users must tab through each block to reach the next skip link, breaking the bypass promise. A better alternative is a skip link *per navigation block*, hidden until focused, ensuring every keyboard user can bypass *any* block in one tab stop. Settle it by testing with a keyboard user on a page with three or more nav blocks.

name: Access
text: DECISION: Add a **bold, full-width skip bar** at the top *and* bottom of every page, plus **one skip link per distinct navigation block** (header, sidebar, footer, in-page nav). Result: keyboard users bypass all blocks in one tab stop; sighted users see minimal clutter. Owner: accessibility-w1.
